data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Synesis', meaning 'divine wisdom' or 'grace'. In Christianity, Sinesia is associated with the virtue of God's graciousness and divine wisdom. The name Sinesia carries the meaning “God's Graciousness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Sinesia usually hope their child will grow to embody god's graciousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine wisdom and God's boundless grace.
data.etymology: Sinesia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Graciousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sinesia total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: סינסיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: סינסיה נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'סינεσις' שפירושה 'הבנה' או 'תובנה'. השם מתקשר לרעיון של הארה רוחנית והבנת דברי אלוהים. במסגרת השם הנוצרי, סינסיה מייצגת את הרעיון של האזנה ותגובה לתפילות, ומבטאת את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Συνεσία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Συνεσία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'σύνεσις', που σημαίνει 'κατανόηση' ή '悟'. Στην πνευματική και θρησκευτική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη σύνδεση με το θείο και την πνευματική悟. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες έννοιες αναφέρονται στη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Sinesia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Sinesia derivatur ex voce Graeca 'sinesis', quae 'intelligentiam' aut 'exauditionem' significat. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen exprimit notionem exauditionis precum et conjunctionem inter Deum et hominem. Historice, nomen hoc in ecclesia primitiva ad significandam gratiam Dei et exauditionem precum usurpabatur.

in_english.name: Sinesia
in_english.meaning: Heard by God, God has heard my prayer

In Christian tradition, Sinesia signifies the concept of being heard by God and the response to one's prayers. Etymologically related to Hebrew and Greek roots, Sinesia reflects the spiritual connection between the individual and the divine. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures to symbolize faith, devotion, and the power of prayer.

historical_references.reference: Saint Sinesius was a bishop of Cyrene in the early Christian period. He is said to have lived in the 4th century AD and was martyred during the Diocletian Persecution.

Saint Sinesius is also known as a martyr and bishop of Corsica during the 3rd and 4th centuries AD. He is believed to have been born in Sardinia and was martyred on Corsica during the Roman persecution of Christians.
